title: Molecular insights into alpha-Lactalbumin-Chlorogenic acid interaction: Peptide design and anti-inflammatory mechanisms.
authors: Zheng, Shuolei; Han, Chuanhu; Zhang, Tao; Zeng, Xiaoqun; Bao, Weichen; Pan, Daodong; Tu, Maolin; Wu, Zhen
one_liner_zh: 研究α-乳白蛋白与绿原酸的分子互作及抗炎肽设计，对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA，方法仅分子对接，与TF-DNA互作课题无关。
abstract: In this study, we systematically explored the molecular interaction mechanism between alpha-lactalbumin (ALA) and chlorogenic acid (CA), and designed the functional peptide TQVYW based on key interfacial residues (THR33, GLN54, VAL99, TYR103, and TRP104) identified from ALA through molecular docking with CA. Furthermore, we elucidated the synergistic anti-inflammatory mechanism of the peptide TQVYW in combination with CA. The study showed that ALA binds CA via hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions, forming a stable molten globule. Further studies showed that TQVYW-CA suppressed reactive oxygen species (ROS) and nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells (NF-kappaB) activation, while reducing both apoptosis and inflammasome formation. It decreased nitric oxide (NO) levels from 40.7 to 14.8 mumol/L (p < 0.001), and downregulated tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), interleukin-1 beta (IL-1beta), and interleukin-6 (IL-6) expression, reducing them by 7.08, 13.65, and 14.08fold, respectively (p < 0.001). TQVYW inhibited lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced apoptosis and inflammation in RAW264.7 macrophages, synergistically enhancing anti-inflammatory effects of CA. This study reveals the molecular mechanism of natural peptide amplification of CA bioactivity and proposes an innovative strategy for the development of peptide-CA anti-inflammatory functional foods.
abstract_zh: 本研究系统探讨了α-乳白蛋白（alpha-lactalbumin, ALA）与绿原酸（chlorogenic acid, CA）之间的分子相互作用机制，并基于ALA与CA分子对接鉴定的关键界面残基（THR33、GLN54、VAL99、TYR103和TRP104）设计了功能性肽TQVYW。进一步，我们阐明了肽TQVYW与CA联合使用的协同抗炎机制。研究表明，ALA通过氢键和疏水相互作用与CA结合，形成稳定的熔球态。进一步研究显示，TQVYW-CA抑制了活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）和核因子κB（nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells, NF-kappaB）的激活，同时减少了细胞凋亡和炎症小体形成。它将一氧化氮（nitric oxide, NO）水平从40.7降至14.8 μmol/L（p < 0.001），并下调了肿瘤坏死因子-α（tumor necrosis factor-alpha, TNF-alpha）、白细胞介素-1β（interleukin-1 beta, IL-1beta）和白细胞介素-6（interleukin-6, IL-6）的表达，分别降低了7.08、13.65和14.08倍（p < 0.001）。TQVYW抑制了脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）诱导的RAW264.7巨噬细胞凋亡和炎症，协同增强了CA的抗炎效果。本研究揭示了天然肽放大CA生物活性的分子机制，并为开发肽-CA抗炎功能性食品提出了创新策略。
